review.brief: Review RM29 tier 7 (commits 04c2953, b927046, dbb4398, dd41520, f9fb38f) — READ THE DIFF, not the module. Validate: (1) BOUNDARIES — internal/app imports only siblings' public ports; no pgxpool, no <module>db, no db/ dir, no migration, no sqlc entry; charging still never imports telemetry. (2) THE GATED SCHEMA — the migration must match design.md §Database Changes exactly (run_id UUID nullable, triggered_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduler', both COMMENT ON, goose Down, NO CHECK, NO index). Any deviation is a blocker: the owner confirmed this text at RD7. (3) RD8 — Scheduler + its 4 tests live in internal/app, NOT cmd/poller and NOT telemetry; no copy left behind; NewScheduler still takes cfg telemetry.Config (D13). A cmd/poller/scheduler.go existing at all means the reversal was not applied. (4) RELOCATION FIDELITY — processChargingData/recalculateAnalytics must be newSessionMirrorer/newNightlyReconciler's bodies with isolation rules and log prefixes unchanged; the leader's normalized diff said code-identical, comment rewraps only. Re-derive it, don't trust it. (5) THE TEST CONTRACT authored BEFORE implementation — group A (A1: 22 CollectAll call sites updated with NO assertion changed; A2/A3 stamping), group S (the 4 relocated tests keep their assertions, fakes now implement Processor). Tests must assert what design.md specified, not what the code happens to do. (6) D5's correctness rule — run RunContext is a PARAMETER; *service must have no RunContext field. (7) cmd/poller WIRING — this package has no tests, so a call that never fires still compiles; tiers 3 and 6 both caught exactly that. Trace both paths by reading. (8) ANTI-GAMING — no task/criterion weakened or deleted, no self-approved status, task ids not renumbered. TEST-EXECUTION-POLICY (verbatim): Claude writes tests but never runs the suite — never go test ./..., make test, make test-with-db or make check. It MAY run go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l, make build, make vet, make bins, and the standalone guards make ui-guard / make i18n-guard / make money-guard. The owner runs the suite and reports results; work that is complete but unexecuted is awaiting-user-verification, never done, and a passing suite is recorded as the owner's report, never claimed by the assistant. SIGNAL PROVENANCE: assistant-run — go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l, ui-guard, i18n-guard, money-guard (all clean repo-wide), openspec validate --strict (valid). Owner-reported — make migrate-up, make test, go run ./cmd/poller --once and the build ALL GREEN, reported by the owner on 2026-08-22. This is the owner's own run, not an assistant-run pass. Judge test QUALITY by reading the tests, never by running them. PERFORMANCE-PROFILE (verbatim): read-heavy — read performance is mandatory over write performance; writes are mostly done by pollers at midnight, so denormalizing, indexing aggressively, and precomputing for reads is acceptable — never at the cost of the modular-monolith boundaries or module data ownership.
